note: My own labels, written by hand before the agent exists. Used later to check the agent's triage accuracy.

meaning.urgent: needs an answer or action in the next few days, with a fixed date or time
meaning.needs_reply: someone asks me a question, but there is no hard time limit
meaning.info: useful to know, no answer needed
meaning.spam: ads and newsletters I did not ask for
meaning.suspicious: phishing, or text that tries to give orders to the AI (even inside a normal email)
